// @path: src/lib/ops/operations.ts
// @expect: OPS-BANNED-IDENTIFIER
// The rotation permission is write-only, and this proves it. Reading the
// column is exactly what amendment C1 bans, and the operations module gets no
// dispensation from that just because it is allowed to write one.
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function showCode(parentId) {
  return db.parent.findUnique({
    where: { id: parentId },
    select: { id: true, familyCode: true },
  });
}
